name: gateforge-monorepo
description: GateForge — An intelligent rate-limited API gateway monorepo

scripts.build: npx prisma generate && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --project packages/gateway/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/dashboard/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:unit: npm test --workspace=packages/gateway -- tests/slidingWindow.test.ts tests/tokenBucket.test.ts tests/rateLimiter.test.ts tests/logRoutes.test.ts
